description: Items that need an owner or scholar decision before anything is re-enabled, re-shown or published. Until an item is resolved, the current handling stays in place. Nothing in this file is rendered by the app.
source: Release v1 completion plan (owner_review list) plus content claims withheld during integration.

items.reason: The segment summary stated that Surah Al-Ikhlas equals one-third of the Qur'an, and its evidence snippet said this comes from authentic hadith. No hadith reference (collection, number, grader) was cited, and the snippet is not verbatim tafsir text.
items.current_handling: Claim withheld. summary_ar/summary_en emptied and the evidence snippet removed in backend/app/data/themes/quranic_themes.json (the verse reference 112:1-4 and the ibn_kathir_ar chunk reference are kept). The API also withholds the stored DB text (backend/app/api/routes/themes.py SUMMARY_WITHHELD_SEGMENT_IDS) until the themes are reseeded.
items.decision_needed: Approve removing the claim, or supply a verified hadith source (collection, number, grader) and the exact wording to show.
